risk_summary: The excerpt combines detailed historical and transaction disclosures with promotional descriptions of an early-stage oncology platform and substantial forward-looking assumptions. Key risks include curtailed R&D due to financing needs, dependence on regulatory and clinical milestones, uncertain companion-diagnostic requirements, and potential registration-related liquidated damages. The tone is cautiously negative on funding but otherwise strongly optimistic about development timelines, costs, and commercial potential.
